newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-KENT WIN TOSS, BAT V SURREY IN BENSON AND HEDGES CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KENT WIN TOSS, BAT V SURREY IN BENSON AND HEDGES CUP.

text.p: Kent won the toss and decided to
bat against Surrey in the one-day Benson and Hedges Cup final at
Kent - Matthew Fleming, Matthew Walker, Trevor Ward, Alan
Wells, Graham Cowdrey, Mark Ealham, Nigel Llong, Paul Strang,
Steve Marsh (captain), Martin McCague, Dean Headley.
Surrey - Alisdair Brown, Alec Stewart, Ben Hollioake, Graham
Thorpe, Adam Hollioake (captain), Mark Butcher, Chris Lewis,
Jason Ratcliffe, Martin Bicknell, Ian Salisbury, Saqlain
